ns2:course.label: Intro MEM Devices & Systems
ns2:course.description: Course presents an introduction to the principles, fabrication techniques, and applications of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS). Students will gain an in-depth understanding of sensors and actuator principles and integrated microfabrication techniques for MEMS. It also consists of a comprehensive investigation of the state-of-the-art MEMS devices and systems. Same as IE 485 and ME 485. Prerequisite: Senior standing in the College of Engineering.
